name_reason: Current name asserts the byte is 'vestigial', which is factually wrong. The byte (=1) is read once by fd2_chapter_27_end (@0x250FA), copied to a stack scratch, and its address passed (with count=1) to fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker (0x1C2DA). That routine DOES dereference it: at 0x1C36A-0x1C382 it computes byte*0x50 + runtime_char_array_base (0x53A45) -> &runtime_char[idx], then reads pos_x/pos_y/sprite_state from that char. Value 0x01 selects runtime_char slot 1 = 悠妮, whose on-field status sprite flickers immediately before she is warped off the field on the bad-ending path. So the byte is a one-element char-index array, not vestigial. Proposed name keeps the data_fd2_chapter_ domain prefix, the meaningful ch27 chapter ID, reflects the data role (a char-index used by the bad-path status flicker), and carries no Ghidra address residue. Rename deferred to Stage 2 (touches the const definition + the local var that mirrors it).
purpose: 1-byte read-only constant (value 0x01) used as a one-element char-index array: fd2_chapter_27_end hands its address to fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker on the bad-ending path, selecting runtime_char slot 1 (悠妮) for the status-effect overlay flicker that plays just before 悠妮 is warped off the field.
logic_summary: Read exactly once at 0x250FA (MOV AL,[0x52326]; MOV [ESP+0x20],AL) into stack local var_10. On the bad-ending branch only, &var_10 is pushed as the 4th argument (char_idx_array) to fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker(0, 0x13, 1, &var_10). The consumer loops i in 0..count(=1), reads char_idx_array[0] (=1), computes runtime_char_array[1] via idx*0x50 + base@0x53A45, and uses that char's position/sprite for the flicker overlay. The byte is never written by the game (single READ xref).
element_semantics: Single byte = runtime_char slot index for the bad-path status-flicker (value 0x01 = slot 1 = 悠妮). Consumed as char_idx_array[0] by fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker with count=1.
comment_original_issue: Both the src comment and the Ghidra PRE-comment claimed the byte is 'vestigial' / that fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker 'ignores the pointee'. This is wrong: the consumer dereferences element 0 (0x1C36E MOVZX EDX,[ESI+EAX]) and uses it as a runtime_char slot index. The 'one-byte addendum to the Y table / facing count or end-marker' guess in the PRE-comment was also incorrect. Physical adjacency to the Y table (0x52316+0x10=0x52326) is coincidental; semantically it is a char-index argument.
notes: Ghidra plate corrected: the existing comment was wrongly stored in PRE_COMMENT (violates the data-plate=PLATE_COMMENT rule) AND asserted the byte was vestigial. Cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT and wrote a corrected PLATE_COMMENT (via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)) noting the name is a pending-rename misnomer and describing the real char-index role. runtime_char stride 0x50 confirmed via fd2-knowledge struct runtime_char (80 bytes). 悠妮 retained as an allowed Chinese character proper noun per ASCII rule. The local var named 'vestigial' in fd2_chapter_27_end and the global symbol itself are left unrenamed (Stage 2); only comments were corrected this stage, so comments now intentionally diverge from the not-yet-renamed identifiers until Stage 2 propagates the rename.
